changelog:
vc-ai-infra-scout 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Launches a multi-step pipeline for VCs to source AI-infrastructure deals using live signals from Hacker News, Product Hunt, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and the web.
- Runs as a SELAT skill, routing all steps via vetted, price-capped ($0.02–$0.05/step, $0.40 max) paid API endpoints with USDC payments from the user’s own self-custody Circle wallet.
- Supports dry-run (no wallet or funds needed) to preview real-time API prices before user opts in.
- CLI workflow includes clear instructions for installation, dry-run, wallet setup, and skill execution with customizable queries.
- User instructions emphasize privacy, no key handling, user-controlled wallet, and safety of declarative (non-executable) skill manifests.
summary: Deal-sourcing scout for VCs running an AI-infrastructure thesis — AI infra, crypto-AI/decentralized-AI, robotics/embodied-AI, agentic payments.
